jobs.description:
Business Analyst (Junior or Senior) — Ghent
 

Are you ready to learn fast and make a real impact, working side by side with a small, close-knit team in Ghent? At Corlutions, we've been helping companies grow with Odoo since 2019, and we're expanding our team to do even more of that.
 

 
 

About Corlutions
 

Corlutions is a digitalization partner for small and medium-sized enterprises, specializing in Odoo-based solutions that help organizations reduce costs and increase revenue. We work closely with clients across sectors like manufacturing, construction, wholesale, and finance — always living by our principle: "Together is better."
 

 
 

What is a Business Analyst at Corlutions?
 

As a Business Analyst, your mission is to help our clients optimize their business processes through smart, well-implemented software — primarily Odoo and Business Intelligence. You'll gather and document business requirements, and translate them into clear functional specifications that guide every project.
 

You'll work closely with clients to ensure optimal use of Odoo apps such as Accounting, Point of Sales, eCommerce, Manufacturing, Inventory, Projects, Websites, Sales and more. By diving into your client's needs and processes, and providing personalized training, you'll become the go-to expert for their management solutions.
 

In your first weeks, you'll get comprehensive training before jumping into your first projects — always with the support of your mentor and colleagues. As you gain experience, you'll gain autonomy too. Collaboration stays key throughout: you'll be in regular contact with clients, developers, and the internal team.
 

 
 

Responsibilities
 

Project Implementation (80%)
 
 

• Gain the trust of your customers 

• Analyse needs, gather and document requirements, and suggest and implement solutions (configuration, development and testing) 

• Provide training 

• Follow-up and communication about ongoing tasks  

Internal improvement (20%)
 
 

• Feedback to the internal team 

• Mentoring and training 

• Feedback for improvement  

Optional: support other domains such as marketing, HR and accounting at Corlutions (impacts the % split above).
 

 
 

What's great about the job?
 

Expect real responsibility from day one, in a friendly and open environment where you'll work both independently and collaboratively. You'll take on a variety of projects across different industries, broadening your experience along the way. As a bonus, you'll go through an in-depth training provided by Odoo.
 

 
 

What we offer
 
 

• Sponsored events — afterworks and team buildings 

• Trainings — a real learning and development program 

• Green coworking space — we work from Pentagon, a green coworking space surrounded by water in Ghent 

• Sport activity — play any sport with colleagues, the bill might be covered! 

• Eat & drink — fruit basket and coffee on the house  

 
 

Ready to start your adventure? Apply now

Must Have
 
 

• Bachelor or Master's degree 

• Fluent in English and Dutch 

• Strong analytical mindset, with an interest in business analysis 

• Good communication and negotiation skills 

• Autonomous, assertive & proactive 

• Affinity with the IT world, and interest in Odoo, ERP and Business Intelligence tools 

• Learn fast and have a "Can Do" attitude  

Nice to Have
 
 

• Background in Business Administration, Applied Economics, Civil Engineering, Computer Sciences, or Business Intelligence experience 

• Fluent in French 

• Experience across different domains (marketing, HR, accounting) is a plus 

• Technical knowledge (XML, Python, JS, SQL, programming)

Inetum is a European leader in digital services. Every day, the Group's 28,000 consultants and specialists aim to make a digital impact for businesses, public sector bodies and society as a whole: solutions that contribute to performance, innovation and the common good.

Present in 19 countries, close to the regions, and with its major software publisher partners, Inetum meets the challenges of digital transformation with proximity and flexibility.

In response to a market that has been growing steadily for over 30 years, Inetum has made the deliberate choice to refocus on 4 core businesses in order to gain strength and offer customized solutions tailored to the specific needs of its customers: consulting (Inetum Consulting), infrastructure and application management (Inetum Technologies), software implementation (Inetum Solutions) and its own software publishing business (Inetum Software). Inetum has forged strategic partnerships with 4 of the world's leading software publishers - Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft and SAP - and is pursuing a dedicated acquisition strategy to become one of Europe's top 5 in these technologies, and offer the best expertise to its customers.

At Inetum Belgium, we offer more than just a job; we provide an inspiring environment and opportunities for growth and development. We strive to create a workplace where you can harness your talents, contribute to challenging projects, and be part of a leading IT consultancy group.

Job Description

Forget about conventional communication styles, the main language we speak is Java. So, If you are looking to upgrade your skills and working on exciting and challenging projects; just scroll down your mouse and learn how you can become the next Java developer Expert Inetum-Belgium is searching for.

As Java developer it will be expected of you:

 
• To share and upgrade your skills through multiple projects ranging from new applications & functionalities developments to complex cross-projects developments. Including elaboration and contribution to maintenance standards.
 
• To share you expertise and exchange about projects status and issues during the Scrum meetings.
 
• To help identify and bring your contribution to key improvements elements of development projects.
 
• To take the lead on the quality of the delivery by playing a proactive role in the testing phases at all the necessary steps of the development.
 
• To ensure the delivery of well designed, testable and efficient code
 
• To coach and help junior profiles on some matters (if you feel comfortable)

Discover your future with inetum belgium

 
• Make a Difference with a Meaningful Career: step into a role where your work truly matters. At Inetum Belgium, you'll have the chance to impact lives and drive meaningful change every day.
 
• Grow and Evolve Professionally: embrace a culture of continuous learning and development. We offer a range of training opportunities designed to help you expand your skills and advance your career.
 
• Unlock Relevant Career Opportunities: pursue the career path you've always dreamed of with tailored opportunities and the IT expertise you need to succeed.
 
• Achieve Work-Life Balance: we value your well-being. Enjoy flexible working hours, the convenience of satellite offices, the comfort of home working, and an informal, no-nonsense environment.
 
• Enjoy Generous Annual Leave: life is more than just work. Take advantage of 32 days of annual leave to relax and recharge.
 
• Travel in Comfort: forget the hassle of commuting. We provide a company car and a national fuel/charging card to keep you on the move. Prefer a different option? You can choose a mobility allowance instead
...

• Experience:

• Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in Java backend development.

• Proven track record in delivering enterprise-grade applications.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Java & backend foundations

• Strong knowledge of:

• Java, including OOP, collections, and concurrency

• RESTful API design and development

• Maven and/or Gradle

• Application architecture patterns such as layered architecture, MicroServices and event-driven systems

• Testing principles and practices

• Frameworks & enterprise development:

• Strong experience with the Spring ecosystem, including Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data and Spring Security.

• Good knowledge of Hibernate/JPA.

• Experience with REST/SOAP services and XML/JSON integrations.

• Platform & Cloud experience

• Experience with:

• Azure and/or AWS

• Enterprise application servers such as JBoss, WildFly, WebSphere or Oracle Middleware

• Tomcat or similar runtimes

• Application deployment, configuration, and runtime behaviour

• Frontend awareness:

• Familiarity with Angular and/or React

• Ability to collaborate effectively with frontend teams

• Integration & distributed systems:

• Experience with API-driven integrations and messaging patterns

• Understanding of distributed and event-driven architectures

• AI & modern development practices:

• Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot.

• Basic understanding of AI/ML services and API integrations.

• Ability to assess AI-generated solutions from a quality, security and maintainability perspective.

• Languages:

• Fluent in English

• Dutch and/or French

Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology?

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.
• Develop test protocols, acceptance criteria and traceability matrices.
• Conduct hands-on testing of sensors, cameras, and modules, covering electrical, optical, mechanical and environmental aspects.
• Automate test procedures using LabVIEW, Python or similar tools.
• Analyze test results, identify root causes and propose corrective actions.
• Improve test methodologies, tools and infrastructure to support scalable industrialization.
• Collaborate with R&D, project management, quality and operations teams to support design reviews and product improvements.
• Mentor junior engineers and share best practices within the team.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.
• Min. 5-7 years of experience in test engineering, validation, or reliability engineering in a high-tech environment 
• Hands-on experience with test automation (Python expertise needed).
• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.
• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.
• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

jobs.occupation: IT Support Technician – L1 Resident Engineer (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
Do you want to be the face of IT at an international airport site, in a demanding operational environment?

Joining SAL International at Liège Airport means ensuring, day in and day out, the continuity of IT services for a multilingual organisation at the heart of logistics and airport operations.

As part of its growth, SAL International is looking for an L1 IT Support Technician – Resident Engineer based in Liège.

WHY JOIN SAL INTERNATIONAL?

SAL International is an international player in airport handling and logistics. What you will find there:

• A dynamic, operational environment at the heart of Liège Airport
• An international and multilingual setting
• An autonomous role: you are the site's IT point of reference
• A solid structure, backed by central IT teams (L2/L3, infrastructure, network, security

Jobomschrijving

As L1 Resident Engineer, you are the first point of contact for all IT incidents and requests on site. You combine deskside support and helpdesk.

User support

• Provide Level 1 IT support, on site and remotely, to employees at the Liège site
• Diagnose and resolve common incidents: laptops, desktops, monitors, docking stations, printers, headsets and peripherals
• Support Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365 environments (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneDrive), as well as basic application support
• Resolve basic connectivity issues (LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN)
• Support meeting rooms and videoconferencing equipment (Teams, cameras, microphones, screens)
Access and security

• Manage access: accounts, password resets, MFA and authentication, in line with security procedures
• Apply IT security policies and immediately report any suspicious incident (phishing, malware, unauthorised access)
Hardware and lifecycle

• Install, configure and prepare IT equipment (PCs, iOS/Android mobile devices, peripherals)
• Handle IT onboarding and offboarding of employees (workstation preparation, handover and collection of equipment, access rights)
• Keep the IT inventory up to date and coordinate replacements, warranties, repairs and disposals
• Tickets, escalation and coordination
• Log, prioritise, track and close tickets in the ITSM tool (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management…)
• Escalate complex incidents to L2/L3 teams with a full diagnosis, and follow them up in line with SLAs
• Act as the link with central IT teams, service providers and external suppliers
• Inform local management of major incidents or service interruptions
• Contribute to IT documentation (knowledge base, procedures, troubleshooting guides)
You are not just a ticket-taker: you are the local IT point of reference and help ensure the continuity of the site's IT services.

THE TEAM & THE MANAGER

Based at the Liège office, you report directly to the Station Manager, Pierre Jeurissen. You work closely with SAL International's IT teams in Belgium and Saudi Arabia.

Essential

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent technical qualification in IT
• At least 2 years' experience in helpdesk, service desk, desktop support or field support
• Fluent French and English, both spoken and written
• Strong command of Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365; basic knowledge of Active Directory / Entra ID (Azure AD) and MFA
• Basic knowledge of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP) and cybersecurity
Assets

• Knowledge of Arabic
• Experience as a Resident Engineer / Onsite Support Engineer
• Experience in the aviation or logistics sector, in an international environment
• IT certifications (CompTIA A , ITIL Foundation, Microsoft…)
Soft skills

• Customer focus and service mindset
• Autonomy and rigour in incident management
• Clear communication with non-technical users
• Hands-on, proactive attitude

Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology enterprise bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this initiative, the company makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases. They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are seeking motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

Start your career in Pharma in a Lab Support role!

Are you ready to make a real impact in the world of biotechnology? 

Are you detail-oriented and comfortable working in a rapid changing, clean environment with very strict procedures? Do you want to contribute to the production of innovative, life-saving cell therapies? Then this could be the opportunity for you.

After extensive training in aseptic working and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), you’ll join our Operations Team and support the production of the Carvykti treatment in a highly controlled cleanroom environment.

What You’ll Do
	
• Support the daily aseptic and manual production process, following strict procedures and quality standards.	
• Prepare workstations, equipment, tools and materials for production.	
• Clean and disinfect materials and equipment to maintain a sterile environment.	
• Inspect equipment and ensure the correct transfer of materials between production zones.	
• Work closely with operators and team leads to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality therapies to patients.
Good to Know
You’ll work in a sterile environment wearing protective clothing. This role follows a shift schedule including weekends. Full training is provided.

We are looking for you if:
	
• You live near Gent/Zwijnaarde or have reliable transportation such as bike or Car.	
• Fluent in English, you thrive in teamwork and are eager to learn new skills.	
• You are accountable and motivated to make a difference in patient's lives. 	
• Your attention to detail is unmatched.	
• Bonus points for familiarity with GMP standards, aseptic techniques, sterilization methods, and MS Office.

Company

Founded in Belgium in 1935, our client has grown into an international leader in sustainable packaging solutions. Their packaging—from corrugated cardboard and solid board to tubes and protective corners—is produced with recycled paper and is 100% recyclable and biodegradable. With a long-term vision and focus on sustainability, they combine ecological and economic progress. Their products, relationships, and management style all contribute to a greener planet. Today, our client has 6,500 employees, spread across 70 locations in 21 countries. The headquarters is located in Aalst.

Jobomschrijving

For the location in Hoogstraten, our client is looking for enthusiastic operators.

Curious about how paper and cardboard are made? With our client, you will learn it all!

As an operator, you play a crucial role in the production process. These are your responsibilities:
	
• Setting up, operating, and monitoring machines for the production of paper and cardboard products.	
• Starting and stopping machines according to prescribed procedures.	
• Performing quality checks on products during the production process.	
• Ensuring a smooth production process with your colleagues.	
• Performing first-line maintenance on the machines.	
• Reporting technical malfunctions and working with the technical department to resolve them.
Monitoring the safety instructions and ensuring they are applied in the workplace

Eager to learn and interested in growth opportunities? Then you are the operator our client is looking for!
	
• Working in a production environment doesn’t scare you, even if it’s noisy.	
• You are a handy person with an interest in technology.	
• You value safety, order, cleanliness, and quality.	
• You are open to feedback and see it as an opportunity to grow.	
• You demonstrate responsibility and are always ready to help others.	
• You have basic PC skills.	
• You will be employed in a 2-shift or 5-shift system.	
• You speak good Dutch or English.

Since its founding in 1891, a culture of continuous innovation has made our client one of the world's leading manufacturers of heavy trucks and buses.

It's unique modular product system, developed over several decades, is one of our key success factors. It is an integral part of our flexible approach and lies at the heart of our business model.

Jobomschrijving

You will independently perform maintenance and repair work on our fleet of vehicles, including trucks and buses.
You'll work with a premium brand, and we’ll turn you into a true specialist in your field!

You’ll join a close team of experienced technicians, all working together toward one goal: providing fast and efficient service to our customers.

We are looking for a passionate mechanic with:
	
• Technical training (A2 or bachelor's degree) in automotive mechanics, electricity, or truck technology.	
•  	
• Knowledge of or experience with heavy vehicles such as trucks, agricultural vehicles, or forklifts.	
•  	
• The ability to work independently.	
•  	
• The motivation to continuously learn through our training programs.	
•  	
• You speak good Dutch or good English.

Our client is an international environmental services company dedicated to protecting the planet with sustainable mobile filtration solutions for liquids and gases.

They have approximately 450 employees, united as Generation D., all committed to driving positive ecological change across various industries.

Jobomschrijving

What does a Process Operator ?

Quality responsibility – You ensure the optimal production of high-quality reactivated carbon by precisely adjusting process parameters to maintain excellent production output.

Operational responsibility – You start up, operate, monitor, and shut down various technical installations to ensure uninterrupted production.

Problem-solving – When technical malfunctions occur, you analyze the cause and perform necessary repairs or adjustments to maintain production efficiency.

Process optimization – You actively contribute ideas for improvements to enhance efficiency and sustainability in production processes.

Forklift operation – You will use a forklift for various tasks, ensuring a smooth and safe production process.

Why You?

Are you ready to work in a dynamic and innovative environment where you can continuously contribute to improvements? Then you might be the perfect candidate!

 

Your Team as a Process Operator

You will join a fantastic team of technical operators and forklift drivers in Rumbeke, reporting directly to your team lead.

Who Are We Looking For?
	
• A strong technical background (mechanics, electricity, etc.) and a passion for technology and innovation.	
• Fluent in English and/or Dutch.	
• Forklift certification required.	
• Analytical and problem-solving skills – You can quickly detect and resolve technical issues.	
• Hands-on mentality – You are proactive and not afraid to get your hands dirty.	
• Team player – You can work well in a team but are also capable of working independently.	
• Flexibility – Willing to work in a shift system.	
• Safety-conscious – You always prioritize safety and strictly follow procedures.	
• Even if you don’t meet all the criteria but strongly identify with our core values – Teamwork, Excellence, and Devotion – we encourage you to apply!

About the Company

Our client is a leading logistics partner for the frozen food sector, serving industries, retailers, and foodservice companies. The company offers specialized frozen storage, inventory management, and logistics solutions, and is known for its stable operations, strong growth, and focus on employee wellbeing.

Jobomschrijving

Are you a hands-on person who enjoys physical work and thrives in a dynamic warehouse environment? Are you accurate, motivated, and not afraid of working in cold temperatures? Then this opportunity is for you!

For a stable and international logistics company in Oostkamp, specialized in frozen food storage and distribution, we are looking for motivated Order Pickers to strengthen the team.

Your tasks include:
	
• Picking orders using a voice-picking system or scanner	
• Checking products for quality and quantity	
• Preparing orders for shipment	
• Operating a standing Electric Pallet Truck (EPT)	
• Handling goods in a frozen warehouse environment (-22°C)

We are looking for candidates who:
	
• Have experience as an Order Picker 	
• Have experience operating an Electric Pallet Truck (EPT)	
• Are physically fit and enjoy active work	
• Work accurately and follow instructions carefully	
• Speak English or Dutch	
• Are reliable, motivated, and looking for long-term employment	
• Are comfortable working in a frozen environment (-22°C)

Our client is a well-established company operating in all segments of passenger transport, including public transport, school and company transport, and coach tourism services. With multiple locations across Belgium and Luxembourg, they are looking for a skilled Bus Mechanic to strengthen their garage team in Affligem or Lede.

Jobomschrijving

 

Your Responsibilities
	
• Independently perform both simple and complex mechanical and electrical repairs and installations on buses.	
• Carry out preventive maintenance and diagnostics.	
• Report all maintenance and repair work accurately using the company's garage application.	
• Take the lead when necessary and provide support and guidance to fellow technicians.	
• Participate in technical training courses provided by various bus manufacturers.

You have a solid technical background in vehicle mechanics.

You have knowledge of vehicle electronics and can read electrical diagrams.

You are passionate about technology and work accurately, safely, and independently.

You hold a technical secondary education (TSO) diploma in Automotive Technology or have equivalent experience.

You are proactive, able to identify technical issues, and find effective solutions.

You communicate well in English, Dutch, or French.

Experience with the maintenance of suspension systems, brakes, filters, and general vehicle servicing is required.

Experience working on trucks is an advantage; experience with buses is even better.

A Category B driving licence is considered an asset, as occasional roadside assistance may be required.

Our client is the world's largest vertically integrated manufacturer of polyurethane foams. The company serves a diverse global marketplace with innovative polyurethane chemical solutions, polyester fibers, and insulation materials. With a network of more than 60 production facilities worldwide, our client has established itself as a global industry leader, recognized for its high-quality products, advanced manufacturing technologies, and commitment to employee development.

Jobomschrijving

As a Machine Operator, you will be responsible for:
	
• Operating and setting up production machines according to production guidelines and specifications.	
• Cutting and processing foam blocks based on customer and production requirements.	
• Performing quality checks on finished products, including dimensions, shape, color, and compliance with specifications.	
• Using measuring tools during the production process.	
• Registering production data and labeling products in the Carpy system.	
• Transporting materials and products between workstations using an electric pallet truck.	
• Ensuring the proper operation of machinery and carrying out basic maintenance tasks when required.

Requirements
	
• Previous experience in a production or manufacturing environment.	
• Technical aptitude and an interest in operating machinery.	
• Ability to work independently with a strong sense of responsibility and attention to quality.	
• Good teamwork and communication skills.	
• Working knowledge of English or Dutch sufficient for workplace communication.
